candidate_correction.trigger: The first read-only compatibility audit terminated before producing any accept/reject result.
candidate_correction.defect: A newline inside a quoted shell token recursively re-analyzed the unchanged command.
candidate_correction.fix: Recurse only when top-level newline splitting produces more than one segment, with a synthetic quoted-newline regression case.

development_disclosure.note: The v3 rejection of compound observational commands in development trajectories motivated a benchmark-independent shell-semantics revision. The frozen grammar and corpus contain no repository or case identifiers.

change_policy: Any accepted-language or safety change requires a new policy identifier, new hashes, and a new freeze record before benchmark replay.
